stages.reading: The agent reads what it was given and what is connected. The feed in the chat shows one tool call per line; each line reveals plan rows (Read.rv keys). The composer is off ('Reading…'). Ends with 'draft the plan' and the steps appear.
stages.questions: Only what the reads could not find, one card at a time (kind 'q'). A card folds to one line when answered: by tile, by text, by Edit on the plan row, or by a document from a connector that answers it.
stages.plan: No open question. Status pill 'Ready to agree' / 'Ready to arm'. Chips offer the main changes; free text that matches no chip is added to 'What I'm taking as given'. Changes that touch a step show a diff card first (Apply / Leave it). Every change bumps the version and lands in Changes and the Log. Footer button: 'Agree and run' or 'Arm the watch'.
stages.running: (once) The plan is agreed. Steps run on the run script; each completion writes an event line; findings land as steps finish, provisional until 'ready'. A checkpoint stops the run ('wait'): for the rate base, how the nine completed projects in CWIP are treated. Pause and resume; steer (diff, stale, re-run); fork (one at a time). Then 'ready', accept findings, choose ('accepted'): the goal moves to Executed; outputs are built in Submissions.
stages.armed: (watch) The plan is armed (armedAt, armedBy, nextCheck). Nothing runs until the rule fires or the schedule is due ('Simulate tonight’s order load (20 October)' or 'Simulate: run now' in the demo). On firing: a notification (toast and bell) says it fired; status 'fired' while the five steps run by themselves; 'ready' when the note is sent, with a second notification carrying what it found and what it recommends. The run waits under Needs you. Choose shows an execute card ('confirm'); nothing happens until Execute ('executing', then 'executed'); a third notification; the run moves to Executed and the watch stays armed.

journeyBarRule.brief: stage reading or questions (sub: answered of total)
journeyBarRule.armed: watch: stage armed and status armed
journeyBarRule.run: stage running and status running/wait/paused, or status fired (sub: done of N, checkpoint, or paused)
journeyBarRule.findings: findings exist and not all accepted (sub: accepted of total)
journeyBarRule.send: (once) chosen; done once an output is started in Submissions or marked sent

notifications.toast: Top right, with a call to action (Watch it run, Review it, Open the goal)
notifications.bell: Every notice stays in the bell drawer; unread count on the bell

execute.note: A standing goal’s recommendation is executed only after Execute; each option has its own four steps.
execute.byOption: Recorded for option 1 in transcripts/watch_rule_03_executed.json (exec.steps); options 2 and 3 follow the same four-step shape.

dock: While the card waiting for you is scrolled out of sight, a bar docks above the message box: 'Waiting for you: <step>' (or 'In progress'), with 'Go to it'.
resumeLine: Reopening a goal with history shows one line: 'Back on this. Step n of N, <label>. Next: <what it needs>.'

listGroups.Needs you: once goals in reading/questions/plan or waiting/paused; watch goals being briefed; every standing-goal run that fired and waits for your review (titled with the run label, e.g. Order load, 20 October · 14 lines off-framework)
listGroups.Findings ready: once goals running and not waiting, not yet chosen
listGroups.Standing goals: every armed watch; an armed one carries 'Simulate tonight’s load' / 'Simulate: run now'; one with a fired run reads 'Armed · 1 run waits for you'
listGroups.Executed: once goals with a chosen recommendation; standing-goal runs once executed
listGroups.Saved plans: saved plans with 'new goal from it'; the start screen shows them as 'Or start from a saved plan' cards

startScreen.composer: Textarea, attachments, a + menu (Upload from your computer; Connected: Web search toggle, OneDrive, Outlook, Azure SQL), the web-search pill, Send.

caseDetection.once: 'rate base', 'belmara', 'used and useful', 'prudent', 'prudence', 'depreciation', 'bpuc', 'test year' → case once; 'off-framework', 'framework', 'order load', 'order line(s)', 'spot supplier' → case overrun-once (the watch analysis run once); otherwise generic
caseDetection.watch: 'each quarter', 'every quarter', 'after every quarterly close' style words or the schedule example → kind schedule; 'procure', 'framework', '2.5%', 'benchmark', 'order line', 'off-framework', 'spend' → case watch (rule); otherwise generic rule

timings.readLine: 520 to 780 ms per read line; 600 ms per attached document; 650 ms for draft the plan; typing dots 600 to 800 ms
onceRun: n1 done, n2 and n3 running, F1 lands
n2 done, F2 (or F2b) lands; checkpoint or straight on
after the checkpoint: n4 running (and f1)
n4 done, F4 lands, n5 running
watchRun: w1 done, W1 lands, w2 and w3 running
w3 done, W3 and W4 land, w4 running
steerRerun: n2 done again (contentKey n2b), F2 → F2b

controls.Edit on a plan row: prefills the composer with '<Label>: ' and marks the row; a message that starts with a row label changes that row (four, t3, fires and tell are parsed into the canonical choice)
controls.Fork a what-if: three assumptions: the 2026 depreciation study rates (rc), the seven make 31 December (t3), the nine stay in CWIP (four); the fork sits beside the prudence step and shares steps 1 to 3
controls.Checkpoint tiles: Count them as completed construction (june) / Leave them in CWIP, as booked (standin: steps 2 and 3 re-run with contentKey n2b) / Run both (adds the fork four)
controls.Steer chip: 'Leave the nine in CWIP' → diff card → Apply: steps 2 and 3 stale then done, F2 → F2b, the rate base and the recommendations move to $1,065.8M
controls.Accept / Challenge: per finding or Accept all; a challenge takes one sentence and keeps the finding open
controls.Why this / Choose / Prefer this instead: on the recommendation cards; Choose is enabled once all findings are accepted
controls.Execute / Not now: (watch) after Choose; Execute runs the option’s four actions; the first drafts the output in Submissions
controls.Build the schedules in Submissions: starts the submission from the output’s library template with the goal attached (registered under the base goal id g-belmara-rate-base)
controls.Save this plan: adds a saved plan to the list
controls.Make it standing: prefills Keep watching with the quarterly rate base refresh
controls.Simulate: fires the rule (order load of 20 October 02:00) or runs the schedule now
